prepare_input.purpose: Confirm the identified separate input aliquot, preservation state and selected sample-specific SOP.

stabilize_rna.purpose: Select and confirm preservation or removal of stabilization reagent according to the Cell protocol.

lyse_homogenize.purpose: Prepare a suitable lysate with the selected kit and sample-specific method.

remove_gdna.purpose: Pass the RNA lysate through the distinct gDNA Eliminator column and KEEP its RNA-containing flow-through in the identified gDNA collection vessel.

decide_rnase.purpose: Resolve the selected SOP RNA-removal branch before AL lysis; any selected treatment belongs to that confirmed pretreatment, not to a later lysate cleanup.

condition_binding.purpose: Establish the selected kit binding conditions without substituting extraction chemistry.

bind_column.purpose: Bind the selected analyte on its own kit-specific column and retain the sample-column association.

wash_column.purpose: Apply the complete kit-specific wash sequence, collection-tube changes and flow-through handling.

dry_column.purpose: Perform the selected membrane-drying procedure before changing to the retained-product vessel.

elute.purpose: Collect the extracted product in its identified retained elution vessel.

handover_qc.purpose: Retain the product, reconcile vessels/waste and request an analyte-appropriate QC workflow.

limitations: Abstract preparation phases, not a replacement manufacturer SOP or executable laboratory recipe.
No extraction runner, stock booking, resource reservation, robot path, device command or expected yield.
Existing manual measurement workflows cannot yet retain extraction products or book reagent and mass consumption.
The current NanoDrop/Qubit synthetic profiles must be checked or extended for the selected analyte and assay before QC integration.
